scope: Bounded retrospective public-data pilots. This freeze precedes extraction of the new numerical functional outcomes, after reading source methods, published conclusions, sequences and metadata. It is not preregistered biological validation.

A.primary: PTDH3-URA3 in SC-URA; S7 column J. This requires native URA3 function and has three labeled biological replicates in the earlier library study, but S7 provides only their pooled genotype fitness, not double-mutant replicate estimates.
A.sequence: Use pinned author Ref_URA3.fasta from Experror commit 286f6894fef31a82d26691a9b61f0f6e39b63af7. CDS positions 1-804 including the stop. All four reconstructed CDS translations, including stop, must be identical. Verify reference allele at every named position. Exclude outside-CDS changes, duplicate sites, missing values and nonpositive/nonfinite relative fitness. These are reconstructed author-called genotypes, not newly resequenced full integration constructs.
A.normalization: Source methods define Wrightian relative fitness w=((f7/f0)/(F7/F0))^(1/g); WT=1 by normalization. Source analysis subtracts 1 to obtain selective coefficients. The GFP 2026 workflow discards w<0.5; the prior URA3 missingness/selection process is not rederived from raw reads, so conclusions are conditional on reported complete groups.
A.primary_contrast: e=ln(w11)-ln(w10)-ln(w01), with ln(w00)=0. Also report the fitness-scale additive contrast w11-w10-w01+1. Neither is scale invariant.
A.scale_robust_endpoint: On each square, B=max(0,min(y00,y11)-max(y10,y01),min(y10,y01)-max(y00,y11)). Positive B is a strict opposite-diagonal two-peak obstruction, impossible under any monotone transform of an additive two-site field. Nonmonotone global responses and measurement error remain alternatives. No higher-than-pairwise interaction can be identified from these squares.
A.split: From sequence labels alone, development has both mutation positions <=500 (340 candidate groups); validation has both >550 (203); all other groups are quarantined (141). Do not extract quarantined double outcomes or other assay columns. The 50-nt buffer and disjoint mutation sets prevent shared single mutants across the two sets. WT normalization, full reporter context and experimental batches remain shared. This is within-reporter regional computational validation, not independent biological replication.
models: Additive fitness: what11=w10+w01-1; report nonpositive prediction failures.

Monotone Box-Cox global response: transform T_c(w)=(w^c-1)/c, with T_0(w)=ln(w); predict T_c^-1(T_c(w10)+T_c(w01)). Select c on development log-MSE over fixed grid [-1000,-300,-100,-30,-10,-3,-1,-0.3,0,0.3,1,3,10,30,100,300,1000]. Any development-domain failure invalidates that c. Validation failures reduce coverage and are never silently excluded from benchmark comparisons.

Flexible isotonic calibration of y10+y01 to development y11, pooled-adjacent-violators, constant extrapolation. This is a predictive one-index benchmark, not a fully identified latent global-epistasis mechanism. Report its plateau count.
A.prediction_seal: Write validation predictions based on the singles and trained models, and hash that file, before extracting validation double outcomes. Fixed primary error is log-MAE; also report log-RMSE, every row, coverage and failures. Do not tune models after validation.
A.uncertainty: No interaction significance tests, standard errors or confidence intervals from pooled doubles. Report descriptive B persistence when every log-fitness cell can vary independently by epsilon in [0,0.0001,0.001,0.005,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.1]; B>2epsilon is a sufficient box-robust certificate, not an assay-calibrated uncertainty probability. Ties at 0, 1e-12 and 1e-8 are all reported.
A.expansion: Prediction superiority is supported only within this regional test. A mechanism-level expansion additionally requires errors/counts for complete doubles and an independent reporter or experiment. Positive point-estimate obstructions cannot satisfy that gate alone.

B.provenance: Structural data: Science 2024 adm9238, GSE246523, author archive 11235856. Function: Soto et al. Genome Biology 2022 23:170, GSE173283, OXPHOS_RelativeExpression workbook. Genotype-matched WT and LRPPRC KO, cross-study and not same-sample matched. Exclude rescue/addback columns. GEO labels HEK293 whereas papers describe HEK293T; retain the labeling difference explicitly.
B.coordinate_resolution: NC_012920.1 contains N at position 3107. Each GEO population sequence equals the first 16500 bases of NC_012920.1 with N removed (or its reverse complement). Map coordinates through this deletion. Align author cluster sequences by unique 30-mer anchors to native gene sequence; do not interpret their plotting Position as genome coordinates. Accept >=99% sequence agreement; use shared WT/KO A/C bases in initiation windows. The KO cluster label NA is CYTB only if its sequence verifies that assignment.
B.units: Eleven units: ND1, ND2, COX1, COX2, ATP8/ATP6, COX3, ND3, ND4L/ND4, ND5, ND6, CYTB. Within a bicistronic unit average gene-level log changes and average the two initiation-region features. Never split its CDSs between folds.
B.endpoint: For each CDS, y=mean(ln RP_KO2,ln RP_KO3)-mean(ln RP_WT2,ln RP_WT3). x_RNA analogously uses RNA-seq HEK2/3 and HEK_KO2/3. Average y and x within bicistronic units. RP and RNA entries are separately normalized within mitochondrial CDSs; these are relative redistribution endpoints, not absolute protein synthesis or absolute translation efficiency. Compare WT1 inclusion only as a declared sensitivity.
B.simple_features: Delta mean population A/C DMS mutation frequency in coding positions 1-30 at each start, KO minus WT, averaged across the two structural replicates. Also delta mean A/C DMS over complete coding regions, averaging genes within a unit. Native reference coordinate mapping is mandatory.
B.ensemble_feature: Delta mean local two-cluster variance pi1*pi2*(r1-r2)^2 over shared A/C positions 1-30 of each start, with pi normalized by pi1+pi2, KO minus WT. Use the authors' normalized cluster reactivities. This is a local probing-mixture heterogeneity index, not a thermodynamic conformational probability or whole-transcript two-conformer model; cluster labels can swap without changing it. It may contain cluster-fitting and normalization artifacts.
B.exclusions: Require positive finite RP and RNA for every primary replicate; valid shared cluster data on >=8 A/C sites and >=50% of available A/C sites in each initiation window; both active-cluster values and proportions finite and nonnegative. No exclusion based on y magnitude, prediction error or correlation. Require >=9 complete units for modeling. Report all failures before outcomes are interpreted.
models: abundance + initiation bulk DMS + whole-CDS bulk DMS (complexity-matched reference)
abundance + initiation bulk DMS + local cluster heterogeneity (ensemble candidate)
B.validation: Unpenalized OLS with intercept, train-fold standardization and SVD numerical rank diagnostics; leave one complete transcript/bicistronic unit out. No hyperparameter or feature selection. Report every out-of-fold residual, rank/conditioning, log-MAE, log-RMSE, and improvement count. Repeat all folds after removing each one unit to expose influence. This tests transfer among a fixed small set of mitochondrial transcripts, not to new donors, cell lines or perturbations.
B.sensitivity: Use 15- and 45-nt start windows without selection; enumerate functional replicate subsets WT{2},WT{3},WT{2,3} x KO{2},KO{3},KO{2,3}, keeping RNA/RP labels together; report WT1 inclusion separately. These are sensitivity ranges, not confidence intervals. Structural clusters are pooled, so their fitted uncertainty is not available.
B.success: Expansion requires >=10% reduction in both leave-unit-out MAE and RMSE versus initiation-bulk baseline and the complexity-matched simple reference, improvement in >=ceil(0.6*n) unit absolute errors versus initiation-bulk, and a positive average MAE improvement after every single-unit removal. Failure of any criterion closes the predictive-expansion gate for this feature and dataset; it does not refute all ensemble mechanisms.
B.interpretation: An added signal is cross-study association with measured relative function. Abundance, ribosome dwell time, protein protection, shared mitochondrial biology and small n remain alternatives. A negative result is reported without replacing the endpoint or selecting a favorable transcript subset.

resource_cap: One primary assay column for A; eleven units, six low-dimensional models and fixed sensitivities for B. No raw-read processing, whole-library folding or new optimization. Keep GFP and remaining assay columns untouched for a separately justified later cycle.
